name: totaal
description: Totaal: the only external plugin a company of under 100 people installs. It builds the company's own plugins — base plugins chosen for its business, then a personal version for each employee — and keeps them improving from daily use, so one person's knowledge and another's expertise become everyone's. For the whole team, not only developers: a shared company wiki, cloud routines that run without supervision, and onboarding that gets newcomers productive in days.
